question: Should Matrix owners choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94416 as the canonical fix for this issue, or pursue the broader https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94044/API-seam direction instead?
rationale: Current main still has the source-visible retry gap, but two open PRs use closing syntax and the stronger candidate changes Matrix retry/session behavior that should be accepted by an owner before merge.

options.title: Land the focused bridge retry fix
options.body: Accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94416 as the canonical path because it targets the Matrix decrypt retry owner, has live Synapse proof, and avoids broad sync-error filtering.

options.title: Choose the broader sync lifecycle path
options.body: Pause the focused fix and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94044 canonical if maintainers want recoverability handled partly through sync lifecycle classification.

options.title: Request an API seam first
options.body: Ask the contributor to reshape the retry around a maintainer-approved Matrix API boundary before landing either implementation.

recommendation.title: Land the focused bridge retry fix
recommendation.body: Accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94416 as the canonical path because it targets the Matrix decrypt retry owner, has live Synapse proof, and avoids broad sync-error filtering.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest feature-history trail across Matrix plugin migration, E2EE stabilization, and sync outage containment near the affected surfaces.
